witness_description: In S_7 on {0,...,6}, let a=(0 1 2 3 4 5 6) and b=(0 1 2 3 4 6 5). The exact closure <a,b> has 2520 elements.
refutation_explanation: The three claimed possibilities have orders 7, 168, and 5040, respectively, whereas <a,b> has order 2520. Thus this subgroup is none of the listed possibilities, so the universal claim is false.
search_space: The singleton bounded space consisting of the ordered pair (a,b), with a=(0 1 2 3 4 5 6) and b=(0 1 2 3 4 6 5), was swept exhaustively. Its subgroup closure was computed exactly by deterministic breadth-first enumeration.
